title.narrative: Child protection consultancy for two Peru partners

description.narrative:
Through this project, Warmi Huasi will act as a consultant to two partners, CIDAP and DESCO, to develop their child protection policy through a participatory process. They will make use of these partners existing knowledge and lived experience, assisting them reflect on these in order to capture processes and actions to ensure that all children who participate in the projects, whether directly or indirectly, are not exposed to situations where they are at risk, and that these children are considered to have rights, especially rights relating to protection and participation.
The consultancy will consist of four elements: participatory workshops (each lasting around 7 hours), legal consultancy, development of resources and an evaluation workshop at the end of the first year of the child protection policy. Approximately 12-15 people will participate: directors, project coordinators, team members, administrative and logistics staff.
